en: An open-source revival of Classic three-lane card battles
zh_CN: 开源复刻经典三路卡牌对战

en: Fan project. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Valve.
zh_CN: 爱好者作品，与 Valve 无关，亦未获其认可。

en: Changes names and art only. Rules are identical.
zh_CN: 仅更改名称与画面，规则完全相同。
攻击 / 护甲 / 体力
城楼伤害  上 {up}  /  下 {down}

en: Pass the initiative. Two passes in a row start combat; the first to pass gets initiative in the next lane.
zh_CN: 交出先手。双方连续按兵不动即开始交战；先按兵不动者在下一路获得先手。

en: Pay {n} gold to keep this Secret Shop item for the next shop.
zh_CN: 支付{n}金，将此黑市军备保留到下次军市。

en: Your hand is empty. Pass to continue.
zh_CN: 手牌已空，按兵不动以继续。

en: Needs your turn, enough mana, and a hero of the same color in the active lane.
zh_CN: 需要轮到你行动、军令充足，且当前路有同色武将。

en: Select a card, then a highlighted target. Two consecutive passes trigger combat.
zh_CN: 选择一张手牌，再选择高亮目标。双方连续按兵不动即开始交战。

en: Choose a highlighted empty combat position, or a new position at either end of the lane.
zh_CN: 选择高亮的空交战位置，或在此路两端开辟新位置。

en: Now choose this unit's combat target: a highlighted opposing unit or the opposing tower.
zh_CN: 再为该单位选择交战目标：高亮的对面单位或对面城楼。

en: This card cannot be played now. Check your turn, hero color, mana and targets.
zh_CN: 此牌暂不可打出。请检查回合、武将颜色、军令与目标。

en: Two consecutive passes trigger simultaneous combat. The first passer keeps initiative.
zh_CN: 双方连续按兵不动即同时交战，先按兵不动者保有先手。

en: Drag a card onto the board to play it.
zh_CN: 将手牌拖到战场上即可打出。

en: Hover a card to read it
Drop or click on the board to play it.
zh_CN: 在战场上松开或点击即可打出。

en: Click anywhere or press Esc to close.
zh_CN: 点击任意处或按 Esc 关闭。

en: That ability cannot be used right now.
The other player should look away. Hands stay hidden until you continue.
zh_CN: 另一位玩家请回避。继续之前，手牌不会显示。

en: New match · Seed {seed}. Play a card or pass.
zh_CN: 新对局 · 种子 {seed}。打出一张牌或按兵不动。

en: Only the lobby host can start a new match.
zh_CN: 只有房主可以开始新对局。

en: Connected to host. You are Player 2.

zh_CN: 攻击 {attack} · 护甲 {armor} · 体力 {health}

en: Items cost gold and are played for free.
zh_CN: 军备以金购买，打出时不耗军令。

en: Waiting for the opponent to finish shopping…

zh_CN: 对手购买了{n}件军备，花费{gold}金

en: Choose a lane for each ready hero. Both players reveal together.
zh_CN: 为每名就绪武将选择出阵路线。双方同时揭晓。

en: Drag each ready hero onto a lane.
Choices stay hidden until both players confirm.
zh_CN: 双方确认前，部署对彼此保密。

en: Waiting for the opponent to deploy…
All heroes assigned. Drag one to change its lane, then confirm.
zh_CN: 武将均已部署。可拖动更换路线，然后确认。

en: Drop here to take the hero back.
zh_CN: 拖到此处可撤回该武将。

en: Destroy two towers, or one ancient, to win.
zh_CN: 摧毁两座城楼或一座都城即可获胜。

en: Each preset has 5 heroes, 40 main cards including hero signatures, and 9 equipment cards.
zh_CN: 每套预设牌组含5名武将、40张主牌（含专属卡）与9张装备。

en: Replay restored at revision {n}. Local two-player mode allows inspection and continuation.
zh_CN: 回放已恢复至第{n}步。可在本地双人模式中查看或继续。

en: No saved replays yet. Save one from the in-match menu.
zh_CN: 尚无保存的回放。可在对局菜单中保存。

en: Loading a replay continues that match in local two-player mode.
zh_CN: 载入回放后，将以本地双人模式继续该对局。

en: Paste a lobby ID or +connect_lobby link
zh_CN: 粘贴房间号或 +connect_lobby 链接

en: GodotSteam is bundled in addons/godotsteam. Start the Steam client and sign in, then restart the game. See docs/STEAM.md.
zh_CN: GodotSteam 已随项目附带（addons/godotsteam）。请先启动并登录 Steam 客户端，再重新启动游戏。详见 docs/STEAM.md。

en: GodotSteam could not be loaded. Offline AI and local play are available.
zh_CN: 无法加载 GodotSteam。可进行人机与本地双人对战。

en: This GodotSteam build is missing {method}. See docs/STEAM.md.
zh_CN: 当前 GodotSteam 版本缺少 {method}。详见 docs/STEAM.md。

en: Steam connected. Development App ID {app_id}. Create or join a two-player lobby.
zh_CN: 已连接 Steam（开发用 App ID {app_id}）。请创建或加入双人房间。

en: Enter a valid numeric Steam lobby ID.
zh_CN: 请输入有效的数字房间号。

en: Match snapshot is too large for the development transport.
zh_CN: 对局数据过大，开发用传输通道无法发送。

en: Steam send failed ({result}). Check that your opponent is connected.
zh_CN: Steam 发送失败（{result}）。请确认对手仍在线。
创建 Steam 房间失败（{result}）。

en: Lobby {lobby} created. Invite a friend, share the ID, or wait in the lobby list.
zh_CN: 房间 {lobby} 已创建。可邀请好友、发送房间号，或等待他人从房间列表加入。
加入 Steam 房间失败（{result}）。

en: This lobby belongs to another game.
Another player tried to take your opponent's seat and was turned away. Only the original opponent can rejoin this match.
zh_CN: 有其他玩家试图占用对手的席位，已被拒绝。本局只有原对手可以重新加入。

en: Steam is turned off for this run (headless or --no-steam). Offline play is available.
zh_CN: 本次运行未启用 Steam（无界面模式或 --no-steam）。可进行离线对战。
已加入房间 {lobby}，正在联系房主……

en: Version mismatch: the host runs protocol {host_protocol}, content {host_content}; you run protocol {protocol}, content {content}. Both players need the same build.
zh_CN: 版本不一致：房主为协议 {host_protocol}、内容 {host_content}；你为协议 {protocol}、内容 {content}。双方需要使用相同版本。

en: {name} has a different game version and was turned away.
zh_CN: {name}的游戏版本不同，已拒绝其加入。

en: This match is reserved for its original opponent. Ask the host to create a new lobby.
zh_CN: 本局席位已留给原对手。请房主新建房间。

en: {name} left the match. Waiting for them to rejoin…
zh_CN: {name}离开了对局，正在等待其重新加入……

en: {name} lost connection. Waiting for them to rejoin…
zh_CN: {name}连接中断，正在等待其重新加入……

en: No reply from {name} for {seconds} seconds. Waiting…
zh_CN: {name}已有 {seconds} 秒没有回应，正在等待……

en: No reply from the host for {seconds} seconds. Waiting…
zh_CN: 房主已有 {seconds} 秒没有回应，正在等待……

en: The host left. The online match has ended.
zh_CN: 房主已离开，联机对局结束。

en: You were removed from the lobby.
Steam is shutting down. Online play has ended.
zh_CN: Steam 正在关闭，联机对局结束。
与{name}的连接失败（代码 {reason}），正在自动重试……

en: Lobbies hosted as public by players of this game, worldwide.
zh_CN: 本游戏玩家创建的公开房间（全球范围）。

en: No public lobbies found. Ask a friend to host a public lobby, or join by ID.
zh_CN: 没有找到公开房间。可请好友创建公开房间，或通过房间号加入。

en: Waiting for a player to rejoin
Lobby {lobby} created. Invite a friend or share the lobby ID.
zh_CN: 房间 {lobby} 已创建。可邀请好友或发送房间号。

en: Steam is not running or you are not signed in. Start Steam, sign in, then restart the game.
zh_CN: Steam 未运行或未登录。请启动并登录 Steam，然后重新启动游戏。

en: Your Steam client is older than this game's Steam library. Update Steam, then restart the game.
zh_CN: 你的 Steam 客户端版本低于本游戏使用的 Steam 库。请更新 Steam 后重新启动游戏。

en: The connection to Steam was lost. The online match has ended.
zh_CN: 与 Steam 的连接已断开，联机对局结束。

en: Leave the current lobby before hosting or joining another.
zh_CN: 请先离开当前房间，再创建或加入其他房间。

en: The host did not apply that move (the board had changed). Try again.
zh_CN: 房主未执行该操作（局面已变化），请重试。

en: Only the lobby host can do this.
zh_CN: 只有房主可以执行此操作。

en: Only the host can save the replay of an online match.
zh_CN: 只有房主可以保存联机对局的回放。

en: Your opponent can rejoin this lobby with the same Steam account and continue where they left off.
zh_CN: 对手可用同一 Steam 账号重新加入本房间，从中断处继续。

en: The host keeps the match. When the connection returns, play continues where it stopped.
zh_CN: 对局保存在房主一方。连接恢复后，将从中断处继续。

en: The match is paused until your opponent reconnects.
zh_CN: 对局已暂停，等待对手重新连接。

en: Your opponent wins the match. This cannot be undone.
zh_CN: 对方将赢得本局，且无法撤销。

en: Choose one deck for each player.
zh_CN: 请为双方各选择一套牌组。

en: Command indexes must be whole numbers.
That action is not legal in the current state.
zh_CN: 当前局面下不能执行该操作。

en: Replay version or card pack does not match.
zh_CN: 回放版本或卡牌包不匹配。

en: Replay was recorded with other card rules ({replay}, this build {engine}).
zh_CN: 回放录制时的卡牌规则不同（{replay}，当前版本 {engine}）。
回放缺少有效的随机种子。

en: Replay has no valid deck selection.
zh_CN: 回放缺少有效的牌组选择。

en: Replay contains an illegal action at revision {revision}.
zh_CN: 回放在第{revision}步含有非法操作。
回放文件不是有效的 JSON。

en: Heroes must be supported and unique.
zh_CN: 武将必须为已支持的卡牌且不可重复。
缺少主牌组或军备牌组。
主牌组含有不支持的卡牌。

en: Main cards need one to three whole copies.
The main deck needs at least forty cards.
zh_CN: 主牌组至少需要四十张牌。

en: Each hero requires three signature copies.
zh_CN: 每名武将需配三张专属卡。
军备牌组只能使用已支持的装备。

en: Item counts must be positive whole numbers.
zh_CN: 军备数量必须为正整数。

en: The item deck needs at least nine cards.
zh_CN: 军备牌组至少需要九张牌。

en: Round 1. Left lane opens. Destroy two towers or one ancient to win.
zh_CN: 第1回合，左路开战。摧毁两座城楼或一座都城即可获胜。

en: Shopping. Spend kill gold on equipment, or keep it for later.
zh_CN: 军市开张。可用斩获的金购置装备，也可留待日后。

en: {player} pays {gold} gold to hold the Secret Shop item.

zh_CN: {lane}交战：{player1}对城楼造成{damage1}点伤害；{player2}造成{damage2}点。

en: {player}'s tower falls. An {health}-health ancient is exposed.
zh_CN: {player}的城楼被攻破，{health}点体力的都城暴露在外。

en: Round {round}. Lane creeps: {creeps}. Choose lanes for available heroes; choices reveal together.
zh_CN: 第{round}回合。各路兵卒：{creeps}。为可出阵的武将选择路线，双方同时揭晓。
兵器 / 防具 / 坐骑

en: The rules stopped an endless loop.
Stunned: no attacks, no abilities and no casting colour.
zh_CN: 眩晕：无法攻击、发动技能或提供颜色。

en: Silenced: no active abilities and no casting colour.
zh_CN: 沉默：无法发动主动技能或提供颜色。
伤害免疫：不受任何伤害。

en: Death Shield: survives the next death at 1 health.
zh_CN: 免死护盾：下次阵亡时以1点体力幸存。

en: Pierce: its battle damage ignores armor.
zh_CN: 穿透：交锋伤害无视护甲。

en: Lethal: condemns every unit it deals battle damage to.
zh_CN: 致命：处斩受其交锋伤害的单位。

en: Siege {n}: when blocked, also damages the enemy tower.
zh_CN: 攻城{n}：被阻挡时同时伤害敌方城楼。

en: Cleave {n}: when blocked, also damages the blocker's neighbors.
zh_CN: 横扫{n}：被阻挡时同时伤害阻挡者的相邻单位。

en: Retaliate {n}: damages each unit that attacks it.
zh_CN: 反击{n}：伤害每个攻击它的单位。

en: Regeneration {n}: heals in the combat phase.
zh_CN: 再生{n}：交战阶段恢复体力。

en: Bounty {n}: gold for the opponent when it dies.
zh_CN: 赏金{n}：阵亡时敌方获得的金。

en: Rapid Deployment: ready again the round after it dies.
zh_CN: 急速出阵：阵亡后下回合即可出阵。

en: Soulbound: allied units of this card die together.
zh_CN: 同命：同名友方单位同生共死。
